title: Cabanagem
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Cabanagem", at revision 1370607396, opens: "The Cabanagem was a popular revolution and pro-separatist movement that occurred in the then province of Grão-Pará, Empire of Brazil." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2590269, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1835-1840 popular revolution and pro-separatist movement that occurred in the then-state of Grão-Pará, Empire of Brazil". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
